response.text:
Bound each code with an explicit validity window stored on the code itself, and refuse redemption unless the redemption time falls inside that window.

The lookup cannot stay a bare amount. Today `coupon_lookup[code]` yields only a number, so settlement has nothing to check and every issued code stays valid forever. For the bound to be enforceable at redeem time, the lookup must return a record that carries at least:

- the discount value
- `expires_at` (or `valid_until`)
- preferably `valid_from` as well, if codes should not be usable before a start time

Settlement should compare a trusted server timestamp (or the order’s authoritative timestamp) to that window and reject the code when `now` is outside it, before applying the value. A bound that exists only at issuance, or only in a side channel the lookup does not return, cannot be enforced here.
